purpose: Append-only, hash-chained event history for Human Diff Review actions with the current review artifact treated as a derived projection.
rules: Each review identity has its own event ledger bound to app, repository, reviewed commit, observed commit and deployment observation id.
Events have contiguous sequence numbers beginning at 1.
Each event records previousEventHash and eventHash; eventHash is SHA-256 over the canonical JSON event body excluding eventHash.
The first event is review_started and has previousEventHash null.
finding_recorded events contain the complete accepted record_finding action payload.
evidence_accepted contains the complete accepted ACCEPT EVIDENCE action payload.
Event timestamps must be monotonic and follow Human Diff Review chronology rules.
The current Human Diff Review artifact is deterministically rebuilt by replaying events through the canonical workspace action reducer.
Stored review projection must exactly equal the replayed projection after every applied action.
Accepted reviews remain immutable because the canonical reducer rejects actions after evidence acceptance.
The event ledger is operational audit evidence and is intentionally mutable only by append; its contract and verifier code are canonical-registry pinned.
nonClaims: The hash chain is tamper-evident within repository history; it is not an external notarisation service.
Event timestamps record explicit workspace actions, not unobserved review work.
The event ledger does not add review, checklist or certification authority.
